-- Store league table for P5 FY2025/26
WITH params AS (
    SELECT DATE '2025-08-25' AS start_date, DATE '2025-09-21' AS end_date     -- P5 FY2025/26
),
period_days AS (
    SELECT d.calendar_date FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.calendar_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date AND d.is_trading_day
),
trading_days AS (
    SELECT cs.store_id, COUNT(*) AS trading_days
    FROM dim_store cs
    CROSS JOIN period_days pd
    WHERE cs.is_current AND cs.store_id < 900
      AND (cs.open_date IS NULL OR cs.open_date <= pd.calendar_date)
      AND (cs.close_date IS NULL OR cs.close_date >= pd.calendar_date)
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c
                      WHERE c.store_id = cs.store_id AND pd.calendar_date BETWEEN c.closure_start_date AND c.closure_end_date)
    GROUP BY 1
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
store_sales AS (
    SELECT n.store_id, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE n.business_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ss.net_sales / td.trading_days DESC) AS rank, cs.store_id, cs.store_name, cs.format,
       td.trading_days, ss.net_sales, ROUND(ss.net_sales / td.trading_days, 0) AS net_sales_per_trading_day
FROM store_sales ss
JOIN trading_days td ON td.store_id = ss.store_id
JOIN dim_store cs    ON cs.store_id = ss.store_id AND cs.is_current
ORDER BY rank;

-- Check store 116 sales in the period vs rpt_daily_store_sales
SELECT r1.control_total, r2.query_total, r2.query_total - r1.control_total AS gap
FROM (
  SELECT SUM(net_sales) AS control_total
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales
  WHERE store_id = 116 AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-09-21'
) r1
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT SUM(ss.net_sales) AS query_total
  FROM (
    SELECT f.sale_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id = 116 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id = 116 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  ) ss
  WHERE ss.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-09-21'
) r2

-- Check if there are web orders linked to physical stores in store 116
SELECT COUNT(*) AS web_orders_count, SUM(f.net_amount) AS web_orders_net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
WHERE s.store_id = 116 AND f.channel_code = 'WB'
  AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-09-21'

-- Sum all net sales from rpt_daily_store_sales vs our league table query for the full range
WITH params AS (
    SELECT DATE '2025-08-25' AS start_date, DATE '2025-09-21' AS end_date
)
SELECT 'rpt_daily_store_sales total' AS source, SUM(rds.net_sales) AS total
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales rds CROSS JOIN params
WHERE rds.store_id < 900 AND rds.business_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date
UNION ALL

FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key

JOIN params ON TRUE
WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date
UNION ALL
SELECT 'fact_return_line total' AS source, SUM(-r.refund_net) AS total
FROM fact_return_line r
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key

JOIN params ON TRUE
WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND r.return_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date

WITH params AS (
    SELECT DATE '2025-08-25' AS start_date, DATE '2025-09-21' AS end_date
)
SELECT 'excluding staff purchases' AS type, SUM(f.net_amount) AS total
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN params ON TRUE
WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date
  AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag
UNION ALL
SELECT 'staff purchases only' AS type, SUM(f.net_amount) AS total
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN params ON TRUE
WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date
  AND f.staff_purchase_flag
